summary: Frontend translation testing for EvaluationsPage and ReportsPage completed. Fixed critical translation key mismatch in ReportsPage (reports.* -> reportsPage.*), added missing translation keys (title, period), and fixed rating label translation in EvaluationsPage to use dynamic translation instead of stored database value.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.jsx - Changed all t('reports.*') to t('reportsPage.*') to match translation file namespace
/app/frontend/src/i18n/locales/en.json - Added 'title' and 'period' keys to reportsPage namespace
/app/frontend/src/i18n/locales/es.json - Added 'title' and 'period' keys to reportsPage namespace
/app/frontend/src/i18n/locales/fr.json - Added 'title' and 'period' keys to reportsPage namespace
/app/frontend/src/pages/EvaluationsPage.jsx - Added getOverallRatingLabel() function and updated evaluation card to use translated rating labels
context_for_next_testing_agent: Translation testing completed successfully. All pages (EvaluationsPage, ReportsPage) now display correctly in ES/EN/FR. Language selector works correctly. No unresolved translation keys found.

bugs_fixed.issue: ReportsPage showing unresolved translation keys (reports.summary.totalPayroll, reports.charts.payrollByEmployee, etc.)

bugs_fixed.fix: Changed all t('reports.*') to t('reportsPage.*') in ReportsPage.jsx

bugs_fixed.root_cause: Keys were not defined in the reportsPage namespace in translation files
bugs_fixed.fix: Added 'title' and 'period' keys to en.json, es.json, and fr.json

bugs_fixed.issue: EvaluationsPage rating labels showing in Spanish ('Bueno') regardless of selected language
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Rating was being displayed from database stored value (evaluation.rating) instead of being translated dynamically
bugs_fixed.fix: Added getOverallRatingLabel() function and updated evaluation card to use translated rating based on overall_score
